newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent ends down 10 cts in erratic, technical fall.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent ends down 10 cts in erratic, technical fall.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures closed down 10 cents on Wednesday in an erratic afternoon slide driven by technical selling in New York, traders said.
Front month April Brent settled at $19.40 a barrel, 25 cents off the low, after swinging wildly throughout the afternoon.
Traders said lacklustre support for Brent from bullish U.S. crude stock data was crushed by selling pressure on April WTI originating in derivatives plays by a Wall Street trader.
"There's been no headlines apart from the stocks and so the technicals took over," a trader said. Support for April Brent was at $18.84 and $18.68, with resistance at $19.73 and $20.
Several brokers said Brent appeared near the lows and a period of consoldation appeared in order, although volume was weighted more to the lower numbers than the higher ones.

Data from the U.S. Energy Information Administration showed U.S. crude oil stocks down 5.4 percent in the week to February 28. The news, following earlier supportive API numbers, pushed Brent to a high of $19.73 in the morning.
IPE gas oil futures last traded down $1.75 at $162 a tonne and at the day's low, pulled down by lower Brent and U.S. heating oil.

"I'd be surprised if we haven't seen the bottom now (on gas oil)," said GNI commodity broker Lawrence Eagles. "The low on the front month position of $159.50 is going to provide reasonably good support. The market is going to find itself battling against resistance at $171."
April NYMEX crude traded down 16 cents at $20.50.
